items.original: How the Texas-required Good Faith Exam works at ThrIVe: video or in-lounge, $35 ($45 with bloodwork), credited back to your account.
items.text: How the Texas-required Good Faith Exam works at ThrIVe: video or in-lounge, $35 ($45 with bloodwork), credited back to your account.

items.original: At ThrIVe, your journey begins with a Good Faith Exam to make sure your care is safe, personalized and medically sound. It's required by Texas law — and the fee comes straight back to you as account credit.
items.text: At ThrIVe, your journey begins with a Good Faith Exam to make sure your care is safe, personalized and medically sound. It's required by Texas law — and the fee comes straight back to you as account credit.

items.original: In accordance with Jenifer's Law, a Texas state requirement, all clients complete a Good Faith Exam with a licensed medical provider before treatment.
items.text: In accordance with Jenifer's Law, a Texas state requirement, all clients complete a Good Faith Exam with a licensed medical provider before treatment.

items.original: the exam is required prior to your first service.
